items.html: And then Hochma and the Hasadim were removed from within the garments of the NNH of Ima, as is known, and remained standing naked, in the aspect of Makifim upon the head of ZA; and also the lower half of the Daat, which connects the two crowns, as is known, and likewise the upper half of the Daat — it too remained with them, the half from the side of the Hasadim.
